The role sets the AI strategy and investment priorities, leads the AI Engineering team, owns the strategy and priorities for Management Consulting-specific technology, software, data, knowledge-management workflows and subscriptions, and acts as the principal Management Consulting stakeholder for Teneo IT on centrally managed technology, data platforms and services.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The role connects Management Consulting&#39;s priorities with Teneo&#39;s central AI team, Teneo IT and other control and enabling functions. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times\u2014connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille\u2122, Words With Friends\u2122, Zynga Poker\u2122, Game of Thrones Slots Casino\u2122, Wizard of Oz Slots\u2122, Hit it Rich! Slots\u2122, Wonka Slots\u2122, Top Eleven\u2122, Toon Blast\u2122, Empires &amp;amp; Puzzles\u2122, Merge Dragons!\u2122, CSR Racing\u2122, Harry Potter: Puzzles &amp;amp; Spells\u2122, Match Factory\u2122, and Color Block Jam\u2122\u2014plus many more!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you&#39;re spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation\u2014and where you can take your career to the next level.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Join us and be part of the play!&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who We Are: &lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At NaturalMotion, we make games that wow people. We innovate to create previously impossible experiences that would not exist without us. We take pride in making titles that reach a large audience and creating communities that last. Our commitment to excellence has earned us recognition as one of the UK&#39;s Best Places to Work in games for eight consecutive years by gamesindustry.biz, and we&#39;re proud to be part of the Zynga and Take-Two Interactive family.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Position Overview:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are seeking a &lt;strong&gt;Server &amp;amp; Infrastructure Engineer &lt;\/strong&gt;to join our server engineering team. In this role, you will work on core backend systems and backend services, contributing directly to live services and build systems with minimal supervision. You will help manage and expand our infrastructure, automated CI\/CD pipelines, and development tools while collaborating closely with technical leads to build reliable, high-performing server environments. You will have a passion for large-scale high-availability systems, a devotion to software craftsmanship, an unwavering commitment to quality, and the desire to have their work seen by tens of millions of people worldwide.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What You&#39;ll Do:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Server &amp;amp; Infrastructure Execution:&lt;\/strong&gt; Complete multi-day backend engineering tasks with minimal guidance. Advanced Skeleton, Rapid Rig, mGear etc.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in animation systems that are scalable and able to work on a wide range of mobile devices.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Complete ownership of pipeline with good documentation and communication.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Bonus Points:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Premium character presentation pipelines - build and own animation systems for high-value front-end moments, ensuring characters are always presented at a premium quality bar.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Automated optimization techniques for the creation of LODs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support a fast paced character pipeline in the delivery of characters per season.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Able to demonstrate knowledge of Facial Rigging processes, game engine compatible solutions and how to implement them.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with motion capture, cleanup and application to different characters.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Knowledge of procedural animation systems.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience in other areas of technical art e.g. Shaders, Lighting Tech, VFX.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What We Offer You:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Competitive salary and discretionary annual bonus scheme&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;26 days holiday, plus bank holidays &amp;amp; Foster strong relationships and ensure alignment with organizational goals for project success.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Take full ownership of the project\/program timeline, proactively addressing risks and dependencies. Implement strategies to keep deliverables on track and ensure timely completion of milestones.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Leads cross-functional teams using Agile methodologies, ensuring efficient delivery of projects by facilitating sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and ensuring continuous improvement throughout the development lifecycle.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Oversees large-scale implementations by managing multiple workstreams, ensuring alignment across teams, mitigating risks, and maintaining project timelines to deliver successful, integrated solutions on time and within budget&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manages stakeholder relationships by ensuring clear communication, expectations alignment, and regular updates; oversees resource allocation to optimize team performance and capacity; tracks budget and burn rates to ensure projects stay within financial constraints; and monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) and business value metrics (BVMs) to assess progress, drive decision-making, and ensure delivery of high-impact outcomes&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Independently handle project escalations, maintaining momentum and customer satisfaction. Swiftly address challenges and implement effective problem-solving strategies.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Exhibit advanced skills in managing nCino project plans and tooling, including task management, resource coordination, and milestone achievement. Ensure alignment with strategic objectives and timely, budget-compliant deliverables.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide comprehensive project status updates and risk assessments to peers and senior management. Your job is to help them work as one organization, raise the bar for how models are developed and operated, and turn more of their work into measurable production impact.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You will lead a distributed group of Data Scientists working on real-time decisioning at global payments scale. The problems range from fraud detection and adaptive risk strategies to authorization optimization, routing and recovery. The common thread is using machine learning to make better decisions on every payment.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This is a player-coach role. You will set direction and develop the organization, but remain close enough to the work to challenge technical choices, lead design reviews and contribute directly when the problem calls for it.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h2>What you\u2019ll do<\/h2><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h3>Set the Data Science strategy<\/h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Create one Data Science strategy across fraud and payment optimization, connected to the wider Payment Performance vision.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Decide where we should invest across models, data, experimentation and shared capabilities to create the greatest business impact.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Build common technical standards and ways of working without forcing different problem domains into the same approach.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Identify where new scientific methods or data assets could create a lasting competitive advantage.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><h3>Turn models into production impact<\/h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own the end-to-end model lifecycle, from problem framing and experimentation through evaluation, launch and production performance.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Improve measurable outcomes across fraud, acceptance and payment cost, with models that operate safely and reliably at scale.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Ensure teams optimize for business and merchant outcomes rather than research output or offline model metrics alone.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Raise the standard for experimentation, explainability, monitoring, drift detection and model iteration.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Work with Engineering to make productionization a shared responsibility: Data Science owns model performance, while Engineering owns platform reliability and deployment infrastructure.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><h3>Partner with Product and Engineering<\/h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Jointly prioritize the roadmap with the Fraud and scientific direction, model quality and technical standards.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Translate complex scientific choices into clear product, customer and investment We own channel performance and optimisation while driving measurable impact at every stage of the customer lifecycle.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a senior individual contributor role, and as our Lead Lifecycle Marketer for EMEA within the global Lifecycle Marketing team, you\u2019ll own lifecycle marketing across the region, partnering with EMEA Marketing and Sales to identify opportunities and deliver programs that support regional growth and business priorities.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll also partner with the global Lifecycle Marketing team to localise and scale global programs for EMEA, ensuring lifecycle experiences are relevant to local markets, audiences, and customer needs. This is a hands-on execution-focused role combining optimisation, strategy, and cross-functional collaboration.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Key Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;EMEA Lifecycle Programs&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own the strategy and execution of EMEA-specific lifecycle programs and campaigns in partnership with regional Marketing, Sales and Partner teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support EMEA Events with lifecycle strategy and execution for key regional and flagship Klaviyo events for prospects, customers and partners, from targeting and invitations through to post-event nurture.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own audience and segmentation strategies using customer, prospect, firmographic, behavioural, and engagement data.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Define success metrics, analyse performance across markets and segments, and turn insights into testing and optimisation opportunities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Global Lifecycle Programs&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with the global Lifecycle Marketing team to localise and regionalise Sales-Led, PLG, onboarding, adoption, re-engagement, and cross-sell programs for EMEA.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide EMEA input into global lifecycle strategy, segmentation, channel optimisation, and testing, using regional insights to improve performance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Product, Growth, PMM, Brand, and other global teams to scale relevant lifecycle initiatives across EMEA.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Cross-Functional &amp;amp; Operational Leadership&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Align the EMEA lifecycle roadmap with global and regional stakeholders, balancing global priorities with market needs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage multiple initiatives, making clear prioritisation and trade-off decisions while maintaining quality and pace.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Champion customer-first initiatives and ensure lifecycle experiences are relevant, scalable, measurable, and operationally sound.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Who You Are&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Experiences &amp;amp; Expertise:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;8+ years in Lifecycle Marketing, Demand Gen, PLG Marketing, Performance Marketing, CRM, and\/or Email Marketing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;B2B and international experience, ideally EMEA within a company with a North American HQ&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong knowledge of lifecycle\/marketing best practices: deliverability, personalisation, segmentation, testing, reporting, channel optimisation, backed by a data-driven approach to audience performance&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Native\/ fluent English (essential). Fluent French\/ German\/ Spanish\/ Italian a bonus.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Tools &amp;amp; Tech:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with lifecycle and CRM technologies including: HubSpot (essential), Salesforce (essential), Smartling (nice to have) and other localisation and marketing automation platforms advantageous&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Monday board or similar&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Cross-functional\/stakeholder&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong cross-functional operator, able to align stakeholders across regional\/ global Marketing, Sales, Growth, Product, Operations teams across different timezones&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Work style&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Execution and delivery focused: Hands-on across strategy, analysis, managing multiple projects and trade-offs in a fast-paced, shifting environment&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Logistics&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Hybrid 3 days p\/ week in the London office&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Full work authorisation to work in the UK without any restrictions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;#LI-Hybrid #LI-JW1&lt;\/h4&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-pay-transparency&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;pay-input&quot;&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;description&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;Our salary range reflects the cost of labour in the country where the job post is advertised. The base salary offered for this position is determined by several factors, including the applicant\u2019s job-related skills, relevant experience, education or training, and work location.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;In addition to base salary, our total compensation package may include participation in the company\u2019s annual cash bonus plan, variable compensation (OTE) for sales and customer success roles, equity, sign-on payments, and a comprehensive range of health, welfare, and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Your recruiter can provide more details about the specific salary\/OTE&amp;nbsp; range for your preferred location during the hiring process.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;title&quot;&gt;Base Pay Range in Local Currency:&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;pay-range&quot;&gt;&lt;span&gt;\u00a380,000&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span class=&quot;divider&quot;&gt;&amp;mdash;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span&gt;\u00a3120,000 GBP&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;This role may require up to 10% travel for purposes such as new hire onboarding, client or partner work if applicable, team meetings, and industry events. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.&amp;nbsp; For more information, please visit&lt;span&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;http:\/\/www.gocardless.com&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt; www.gocardless.com&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/span&gt; and follow us on LinkedIn&lt;span&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.linkedin.com\/company\/gocardless&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt; ----- is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;The role&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Data sits at the core of our mission. We leverage bank account data to deliver high-value, intelligent payment solutions for our customers, from enhancing payment success rates to driving payer fraud prevention.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a Data Science Manager within our Payment Intelligence team, you\u2019ll partner with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Designers to turn big ideas into reality. You\u2019ll own the full lifecycle of our algorithms, shaping everything from the initial concept to production-ready code that powers our global payment network.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At GoCardless, our stack is centered around Google Cloud Platform and Vertex AI, providing a high-performance environment for innovation. Our Data Scientists operate at the intersection of Python, SQL, and BigQuery to build and deploy high-performance models at scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you\u2019ll do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage and mentor a high-performing team of Data Scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and supporting their long-term career development.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of mission-critical ML models that power real-time payment decisions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Shape the strategic roadmap for the Payment Intelligence space, translating complex data challenges into actionable, high-impact goals.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Drive cross-functional impact by working closely across disciplines to build end-to-end technical solutions, from concept to production.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Influence Senior Leadership by acting as the bridge between technical complexity and business value, communicating ML strategy to senior stakeholders.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What excites you&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Driving cutting-edge advancements in Data, AI, and Machine Learning within the payments space with a multidisciplinary team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mentoring a high-performing team and fostering a culture of technical excellence.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Solving the complex, real-time challenges of fraud prevention and payment optimisation at scale.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Building production-grade ML models on a streamlined GCP and Vertex AI stack to drive fintech innovation.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What excites us&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;2+ years managing Data Scientists within complex, high-stakes domains.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A hands-on leader comfortable diving into the codebase. You bring strong expertise in Python and SQL to oversee the full lifecycle of a model, from initial prototype to robust production deployment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A decisive collaborator who can navigate technical trade-offs and translate complex ML concepts for cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Familiarity with complex data environments and model architectures, such as deep learning (experience in Fintech, Fraud Prevention, or Payments is a big plus).&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Base salary range:&lt;\/strong&gt; \u00a399,200 - \u00a3148,800&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.&amp;nbsp; Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the &lt;span style=&quot;text-decoration: underline;&quot;&gt;minimum and the mid-point&lt;\/span&gt; of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;(some of) The good stuff&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Wellbeing &lt;\/strong&gt;- stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Work away scheme&lt;\/strong&gt; - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Adaptive Working&lt;\/strong&gt; - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Parental leave&lt;\/strong&gt; - to suit everyone embarking on life&#39;s great adventure&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Learning Budget&lt;\/strong&gt; - lead your own development with an annual learning budget&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Time off&lt;\/strong&gt; - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (\u2018GC Fridays\u2019)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Life at GoCardless&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re an organisation defined by our&lt;span&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/gocardless.com\/g\/values-operating-principles\/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt; &lt;u&gt;values&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;\/span&gt;; We &lt;strong&gt;&lt;em&gt;start with why&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;em&gt; &lt;\/em&gt;before we begin any project, to ensure it\u2019s aligned with our mission. We &lt;strong&gt;&lt;em&gt;make it happen&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;, working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We&lt;strong&gt;&lt;em&gt; act with integrity&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;, always. We &lt;strong&gt;&lt;em&gt;care deeply&lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt; about what we do and we know it&#39;s essential that we &lt;strong&gt;&lt;em&gt;be humble &lt;\/em&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;whilst we do it. While we are well-positioned to help shape the future of television and streaming media worldwide, continued success stems from experienced software engineers like you developing core features for the Roku platform.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Our new Senior Software Engineer will be contributing extensively to our container orchestrated platform, bringing together some of the latest web technologies with Ai expertise to develop a truly scalable and responsive web applications. This is a great role for an experienced professional who has innovative ideas for complex problems and can translate these ideas into ultra-reliable software.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;How will I use AI at Roku?&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;At Roku, we don\u2019t just use AI, we work with it. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Agents and automations.&lt;\/strong&gt; Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo&#39;s own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions.&lt;\/strong&gt; Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Post-sale health checks and expansions.&lt;\/strong&gt; Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Reusable assets.&lt;\/strong&gt; Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Thought leadership.&lt;\/strong&gt; Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Product feedback.&lt;\/strong&gt; Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;How you This is a new seat, and it exists because security work needs dedicated capacity. Absorbed as background tasks between feature tickets, it never gets the focus it deserves. You would be that dedicated capacity.<\/p>\n<p><strong>This is a Linux-first, hands-on engineering role.<\/strong> You will not write policies for other people to implement \u2014 you will write the Python and Bash that hardens our OS, automates our vulnerability management, and proves to auditors and customers that our supply chain is sound.<\/p>\n<\/div>\n<\/div><br><strong>About Scality<\/strong><br><p>Scality is the leader in software-defined object storage, trusted by 1,000+ enterprises and 700M+ users worldwide across banking, healthcare, and government sectors \u2014 exactly the sectors where security posture is a purchasing criterion, not a checkbox.<\/p>\n<p><strong>Industry recognition:<\/strong><\/p>\n<ul style=\"list-style-type: disc;\">\n<li><strong>Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader for 9 consecutive years<\/strong>&nbsp;\u2014 the only 100% software-defined storage company to hold this position since the quadrant\u2019s inception<\/li>\n<li><strong>#1 on the GigaOm Radar for Enterprise Object Storage<\/strong>&nbsp;(2024), ahead of 17 competing vendors<\/li>\n<li><strong>Gold Stevie Award 2025<\/strong>&nbsp;\u2014 ARTESCA 3.0, Cloud Storage &amp; Backup Solution category<\/li>\n<li><strong>Net Promoter Score of 85<\/strong>&nbsp;across RING and ARTESCA<\/li>\n<\/ul><br><strong>About the team<\/strong><br><div>\n<p>You will join a small team of highly skilled Linux engineers responsible for delivering and maintaining&nbsp;<strong>ADI<\/strong>&nbsp;(Scality Autonomous Data Infrastructure), our full platform:&nbsp;<strong>RING<\/strong>&nbsp;(object storage),&nbsp;<strong>S3C<\/strong>&nbsp;(S3-compatible layer), and&nbsp;<strong>SCOS<\/strong>&nbsp;(Scality OS \u2014 our own Linux distribution).<\/p>\n<p>The team works across the full stack of infrastructure engineering \u2014 deep Linux system integration, RPM packaging, CI\/CD pipelines, monitoring, and release automation. The command line is where most of our day happens, and we ship a Linux distribution to customers.<\/p>\n<\/div><br><strong>How We Build<\/strong><br><div>\n<p>We build with AI tools, in earnest rather than as an experiment. Every engineer here has Claude Code, and it is part of how we write, review, and ship code day to day.<\/p>\n<p>We are also designing something larger: an&nbsp;<strong>AI code and delivery factory<\/strong>&nbsp;\u2014 AI woven into the build and release chain itself, not just into the editor. That work is early and still being thought through rather than already solved. We expect it to become part of how we maintain the platform, and CVE remediation is one of the first places we think it fits: an automated path from advisory to assessment to a patched, tested, delivered build.<\/p>\n<p>If that sounds like a problem you would want to work on, this role sits close to it.<\/p>\n<p>One principle is not negotiable:&nbsp;<strong>a human owns the outcome.<\/strong>&nbsp;AI writes code here, and when it does, we own what it produces \u2014 the review, the decision to ship, the consequences, and the fix. \u201cThe tool did it\u201d is not an explanation we accept from ourselves, and it is not one we would offer a customer. In security work that matters doubly: an answer you cannot defend is worse than no answer at all.<\/p>\n<\/div><br><strong>How This Role Works<\/strong><br><div>\n<p>Scality is building a&nbsp;<strong>network of security engineers across the engineering department<\/strong>&nbsp;\u2014 a security peer embedded in each development team, rather than a central security function working at arm\u2019s length from the code. You would be that peer for the platform and delivery team.<\/p>\n<ul style=\"list-style-type: disc;\">\n<li><strong>Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering.<\/strong>&nbsp;The agenda is set at that level, with dedicated resources committed across the teams. You will not have to invent it alone \u2014 and you will have a voice in it: the engineers closest to the code help decide what goes on the roadmap. We will be straight with you: today security work competes with delivery commitments and too often loses. Naming an owner and funding dedicated people is how we intend to change that. You would help build that capability, not inherit a finished one.<\/li>\n<li><strong>The team is accountable for the deliveries.<\/strong>&nbsp;Security items sit on the team\u2019s plate alongside everything else it commits to, rather than in a separate function filing tickets from the outside.<\/li>\n<li><strong>You are the dedicated resource that makes them happen.<\/strong>&nbsp;While your teammates carry releases, OS compatibility, and platform features, your time is reserved for the security work. That focus is the whole reason the seat exists.<\/li>\n<li><strong>You share the team\u2019s perimeter and its knowledge.<\/strong>&nbsp;Same repositories, same Jira projects, same code reviews, same sprint rituals. The engineers around you have rare, hard-earned Linux depth \u2014 OS integration, RPM packaging, boot and GRUB, CI\/CD, monitoring \u2014 and you will learn the platform from them.<\/li>\n<li><strong>You will have peers.<\/strong>&nbsp;Security engineers embedded in the other development teams work the same problems on different perimeters. That network is where you compare notes, share tooling, and grow into the craft.<\/li>\n\n<p>The point of the model is that security decisions get made&nbsp;<em>inside<\/em>&nbsp;the team that builds and ships the product, by someone who understands the build system rather than filing tickets against it.<\/p>\n<\/ul><\/div><br><strong>Your First Missions<\/strong><br><div>\n<p>Two priorities are already on the roadmap, and they will shape your first year.<\/p>\n<h3>1. CVE exposure, answered before it is asked<\/h3>\n<p>Customers in banking, healthcare, and government ask us, routinely and under their own audit obligations, whether our products are exposed to a given CVE. That will not stop \u2014 for them, asking&nbsp;<em>is<\/em>&nbsp;the compliance requirement. Today each answer is researched from scratch: a customer question becomes a ticket, the ticket becomes a hunt through SBOMs, vendor advisories, and our own configuration, and the round trip can take weeks to produce something the team is not fully confident defending.<\/p>\n<p>Your first mission is to invert that, so the answer already exists when the question arrives.<\/p>\n<ul style=\"list-style-type: disc;\">\n<li><strong>A standing exposure record<\/strong>, per shipped component and per release: what the SBOM says is present, what the upstream vendor has decided (including \u201cwill not fix\u201d, which is common on RHEL 8 and often the real answer), and whether the vulnerable code path is actually reachable in our configuration<\/li>\n<li><strong>Reachability over presence.<\/strong>&nbsp;A module shipped and loaded by a distribution default is not the same as a module configured on a live URL. That distinction is the difference between \u201cvulnerable\u201d and \u201cno impact\u201d, and it is where the engineering judgement lives<\/li>\n<li>Continuous CVE detection across our repositories, vendored third-party modules, container images, and shipped RPMs<\/li>\n<li>Wiring detection into our existing&nbsp;<strong>SBOM<\/strong>&nbsp;tooling and GitHub Actions pipelines, so exposure is computed when a release is built rather than when a customer asks<\/li>\n<li><strong>A defined interface<\/strong>&nbsp;with the security engineers and the customer-facing teams: who produces the technical assessment, who owns the wording that reaches the customer, and how both meet the response commitments in our customer security policy<\/li>\n<li><strong>Durable capture.<\/strong>&nbsp;An assessment that lives only in a ticket comment gets re-derived next release. Findings belong somewhere queryable<\/li>\n<li>A remediation loop with clear ownership and response targets, integrated with how the team already works in Jira<\/li>\n<li><strong>AI-assisted remediation<\/strong>, where it fits: from advisory to proposed patch to a tested build, with a human deciding what ships<\/li>\n\n<p>Done well, a customer\u2019s \u201care you affected by X?\u201d becomes a lookup and an afternoon, not an escalation and three weeks.<\/p>\n<h3>2. Raising the security baseline of SCOS<\/h3>\n<p>SCOS is our own Linux distribution \u2014 we control the kickstarts, the package set, the boot path, and the images. That is unusual leverage, and we intend to use it. You will drive platform-level hardening across the OS we ship:<\/p>\n<ul style=\"list-style-type: disc;\">\n<li>A hardened, defensible default configuration for the distribution<\/li>\n<li>Advancing&nbsp;<strong>SELinux<\/strong>&nbsp;enforcement across RING and S3C (work already begun on the team, which you will help carry)<\/li>\n<li>Supply-chain integrity: artifact provenance, signing, dependency currency, reproducible and verifiable builds<\/li>\n<li>Secrets and credential handling across the delivery pipeline<\/li>\n<li>Cryptographic posture \u2014 including&nbsp;<strong>FIPS 140-3<\/strong>&nbsp;readiness, which matters concretely: FIPS 140-2 certificates move to NIST\u2019s historical list on 22 September 2026, and RHEL 9\u2019s validated OpenSSL, GnuTLS, and kernel crypto modules are the foundation we build on<\/li>\n<li>Compliance-driven engineering work, notably the supply-chain security expectations of&nbsp;<strong>NIS2<\/strong>&nbsp;(Article 21(2)(d)) and the EU Cyber Resilience Act \u2014 translated into automation and evidence, not spreadsheets<\/li>\n\n<p>You will also contribute to what comes next: threat modelling of the platform, hardening guidance for customers, and security review of significant design changes.<\/p>\n<\/ul><\/ul><\/div><br><strong>What We Are Looking For<\/strong><br><div>\n<p>This is a role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into being their team\u2019s security reference. We expect to invest in you, and we expect you to keep growing here for as long as you want to \u2014 there is no ceiling built into this seat.<\/p>\n<h3>Required<\/h3>\n<ul style=\"list-style-type: disc;\">\n<li><strong>Linux is your primary operating system<\/strong>&nbsp;\u2014 at work, at home, or both. You are comfortable in the terminal and you reach for a shell before a UI<\/li>\n<li>Roughly&nbsp;<strong>2\u20134 years<\/strong>&nbsp;of relevant experience, or a shorter track record with unusually strong evidence of the skills below<\/li>\n<li>Solid working ability in&nbsp;<strong>Python and Bash<\/strong>&nbsp;\u2014 you will be writing and maintaining real code in a production codebase<\/li>\n<li><strong>A genuine, demonstrable interest in security.<\/strong>&nbsp;We care much more about this than about formal credentials. Show it however it is true for you: CTFs, a home lab, reading advisories and CVE writeups for fun, a hardening project, security-adjacent contributions, a blog, anything real<\/li>\n<li>Comfortable using Git in a collaborative environment<\/li>\n<li>Ability to read and understand existing code before modifying it<\/li>\n<li>The judgement to tell a real risk from a scanner\u2019s opinion \u2014 and the instinct to check whether vulnerable code is actually reachable before calling it exposed<\/li>\n<li>The willingness to say plainly when you are not yet sure, rather than producing an answer you could not defend<\/li>\n<li><strong>French<\/strong>&nbsp;\u2014 the team works in French day to day<\/li>\n<li>Written communication skills in English<\/li>\n\n<h3>Nice to Have<\/h3>\n<ul style=\"list-style-type: disc;\">\n<li>CVE triage, CVSS scoring, or vulnerability management experience<\/li>\n<li>Reading vendor advisories and understanding vendor triage \u2014 NVD, RHSA, Red Hat severity and will-not-fix calls<\/li>\n<li>Supply-chain security tooling \u2014 SBOM formats (SPDX, CycloneDX), scanners (Trivy, Grype, Syft), artifact signing<\/li>\n<li>RPM packaging or Linux distribution internals<\/li>\n<li>SELinux policy work<\/li>\n<li>CI\/CD systems, especially GitHub Actions<\/li>\n<li>RHEL \/ Rocky Linux (versions 8 and 9)<\/li>\n<li>Containers (Docker, containerd, systemd units)<\/li>\n<li>Ansible or Salt<\/li>\n<li>Awareness of NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, or FIPS 140-3<\/li>\n<li>Familiarity with S3 or object storage concepts<\/li>\n<li>Serious use of AI coding tools in a real workflow \u2014 Claude Code or equivalent, beyond autocomplete<\/li>\n\n<h3>To Be Clear About Scope<\/h3>\n<p>This is a&nbsp;<strong>software engineering<\/strong>&nbsp;role with a security mandate. It is&nbsp;<strong>not<\/strong>&nbsp;a SOC or incident-response analyst position, not a penetration-testing role, and not a GRC or compliance-documentation role. If what you want is to build the tooling and harden the system yourself, in code, you are in the right place.<\/p>\n<\/ul><\/ul><\/div><br><strong>What We Offer<\/strong><br><div>\n<ul style=\"list-style-type: disc;\">\n<li><strong>Dedicated focus.<\/strong>&nbsp;Security is your job here, not the thing you get to after the sprint work is done<\/li>\n<li><strong>Clear direction, and a say in it.<\/strong>&nbsp;Security priorities are owned by our VP of Engineering, and the team is accountable for delivering them. You would not be inventing the agenda on your own, you would help shape what goes on it, and you would be part of making it stick<\/li>\n<li><strong>A network of peers.<\/strong>&nbsp;Security engineers embedded in the other development teams, working the same problems on different perimeters<\/li>\n<li><strong>Work that compounds.<\/strong>&nbsp;Customer security questions are a permanent obligation, so every assessment you make reusable and every check you automate keeps paying back, release after release<\/li>\n<li><strong>Modern tooling, actually adopted.<\/strong>&nbsp;Claude Code in every engineer\u2019s hands, and a real say in how AI reshapes our build and delivery chain<\/li>\n<li>A rare combination: security work with the leverage of owning the whole stack, down to our own Linux distribution<\/li>\n<li>Mentorship from senior engineers with deep expertise across Linux, storage, packaging, and distributed systems \u2014 you will not be the only person who understands your perimeter<\/li>\n<li>A long-term growth path toward becoming your team\u2019s security reference and a senior voice in the network<\/li>\n<li>Work that ships to production and runs at exabyte scale, in banking, healthcare, and government<\/li>\n<li>Standard French benefits: meal vouchers, Navigo subsidy, mutuelle<\/li>\n\n<\/ul><\/div><p>Find <a href=\"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.fr\">Jobs in France<\/a> on Arbeitnow<\/a>","remote":false,"url":"https:\/\/www.arbeitnow.fr\/jobs\/companies\/scality\/platform-security-engineer-paris-france-59934","tags":["R&D Paris"],"job_types":["Full Time"],"location":"Paris, France","created_at":1791605087},{"slug":"senior-product-manager-public-apis-paris-171863","company_name":"Qonto","title":"Senior Product Manager -
